review:
Jungle ruins on a 5x4 grid with Stackways – symbols stack up to 10 high per reel, for up to 100,000 ways. Medium-high volatility, 10,000x max.

In Stack Spins, landing a special symbol powers up a reel so a Stackways symbol always lands there for the rest of the round. Mayan Gold collects ancient coins, and its rare Golden Opportunity version always pays at least 500x. Great if you like ways games where the reels build up.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw Gaming doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
